senses.gloss: a state of being harmless, pure, or free from guilt

translations.th_TH: ความบริสุทธิ์; การไม่มีความผิด

definition_translations.zh_TW: 無害、純真或無罪的狀態
definition_translations.ja_JP: 無害、純粋、または罪がない状態
definition_translations.ko_KR: 해롭지 않고 순수하거나 죄가 없는 상태
definition_translations.vi_VN: trạng thái vô hại, trong sạch hoặc không có tội

senses.gloss: the legal state of not being guilty of a crime

translations.th_TH: ความบริสุทธิ์

example_translations.ja_JP: 証拠は彼女の無罪を証明しました。

definition_translations.ja_JP: 犯罪について有罪でない法的状態
definition_translations.ko_KR: 범죄에 대해 유죄가 아닌 법적 상태
definition_translations.vi_VN: tình trạng pháp lý không phạm tội
